new_categories.label: cargo_deck_containment_boundary_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-deck containment-boundary readiness is a service-state distinct from the ship/shore connection boundary and from cargo-transfer machinery readiness.

new_categories.label: drainage_path_availability
new_categories.memory: Deck drainage-path availability can degrade or be isolated separately from containment-boundary condition without retaining actual routing or valve positions.

new_categories.label: collection_scope_readiness
new_categories.memory: A bounded collection/retention scope can carry its own readiness state without inferring capacity, level, destination or handling procedure.

new_categories.label: boundary_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Containment-boundary condition confidence is distinct from simple path availability and can be represented without exact geometry or construction detail.

new_categories.label: drainage_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Drainage service condition can be represented separately from whether a path is nominally present or open.

new_categories.label: collection_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Collection-domain condition confidence can be distinct from drainage path and deck boundary confidence.

new_categories.label: monitoring_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring/verification confidence is separable from physical containment and drainage condition without retaining levels, alarm thresholds or test methods.

new_categories.label: transfer_interface_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: Containment/drainage restriction can be localized to an affected cargo-deck or transfer-interface scope rather than generalized to all cargo operations.

new_categories.label: alternate_containment_collection_confidence
new_categories.memory: Alternate containment or collection confidence can be represented abstractly without implying approved routing, transfer, disposal or cleanup methods.

new_categories.label: deck_containment_drainage_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can be attributed separately to boundary, drainage path, collection domain, monitoring domain or transfer-interface scope.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Transfer restriction, pollution-prevention concern, terminal incompatibility, rework or schedule effects do not by themselves prove a boundary, drainage, collection or monitoring root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_containment_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical correction, drainage availability, collection confidence, verification completion and operational release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: connection_containment_vs_deck_containment
useful_refinements.memory: P102 connection-boundary containment is refined by keeping broader cargo-deck containment/drainage service-state separate.

useful_refinements.label: transfer_path_vs_drainage_path
useful_refinements.memory: P092 cargo-transfer path availability does not establish readiness of a separate deck drainage/collection path.

useful_refinements.label: instrument_monitoring_vs_containment_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P103 instrumentation confidence refines monitoring semantics but does not duplicate containment/drainage physical condition or scope.

useful_refinements.label: generic_pollution_prevention_effect_vs_service_state
useful_refinements.memory: Pollution-prevention confidence is a downstream assurance effect and should not collapse the underlying boundary, drainage and collection service states.

duplicates.label: generic_boundary_path_condition_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic boundary/path condition degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_verification_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope-localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact deck containment/drainage/collection arrangements or capacities
exact valve positions, levels or discharge destinations
exact cleanup, drainage-routing, transfer, disposal, testing or emergency methods
named provider, terminal, incident or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact cargo-deck containment, drainage and collection arrangements, capacities, valve positions, levels, discharge destinations, monitoring thresholds, test values and current configuration
exact spill cleanup, drainage routing, collection transfer, disposal, testing, troubleshooting, pollution-response or emergency procedures
named containment/drainage providers, terminals, inspectors, incidents, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional containment/drainage equipment/service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact capacity, routing, discharge, cleanup, testing, procedure, provider or incident detail that is deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive cargo-deck containment/drainage service-state orientation/source-discovery output; not spill cleanup, drainage routing, disposal, testing, transfer or emergency-response advice and not proof of any exact arrangement, capacity, valve position, level, discharge destination, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
